sources.title: DCGM profiling
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Redfish 遙測：取樣頻率、資料量與時間戳
related.titleEn: Redfish telemetry: sampling rate, data volume and timestamps
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：低活動與效能差分開判定；無kernel級證據時不定位程式行。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Low activity and poor performance are distinct; no source line is blamed without kernel-level evidence.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「Redfish 遙測：取樣頻率、資料量與時間戳」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付指標契約、payload預算、量測／接收時戳與缺資料處理。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct Redfish telemetry: sampling rate, data volume and timestamps with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver metric contracts, payload budgets, measurement/receipt timestamps and gap handling.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 將30秒與70秒畫成不同寬度，計面積再除總長。
計算單台320 bytes與100台一輪32000 bytes，再除5。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Draw intervals with widths thirty and seventy and divide total area by total time.
Compute 320 bytes per server and 32000 per round, then divide by five.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Dask Worker 記憶體：managed、暫存與背壓
related.titleEn: Dask worker memory: managed data, temporaries and backpressure
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：低活動與效能差分開判定；無kernel級證據時不定位程式行。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Low activity and poor performance are distinct; no source line is blamed without kernel-level evidence.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「Dask Worker 記憶體：managed、暫存與背壓」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付記憶體分類、兩組峰值、spill磁碟預算與task重算條件。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct Dask worker memory: managed data, temporaries and backpressure with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver memory categories, two peak budgets, spill-disk capacity and task-recomputation conditions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 將30秒與70秒畫成不同寬度，計面積再除總長。
將10+4 GiB疊入16 GiB框，計使用率與80%門檻差。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Draw intervals with widths thirty and seventy and divide total area by total time.
Stack 10+4 GiB inside a 16 GiB frame and calculate utilization relative to 80%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
